cockpit_installations_device_check.name: cockpit_installations_device_check
cockpit_installations_device_check.value: ("cockpit_installations"."kind" = 'desktop' and "cockpit_installations"."device_id" is not null and "cockpit_installations"."device_label" is not null) or ("cockpit_installations"."kind" = 'browser' and "cockpit_installations"."device_id" is null and "cockpit_installations"."device_label" is null)

cockpit_push_subscriptions_kind_check.name: cockpit_push_subscriptions_kind_check
cockpit_push_subscriptions_kind_check.value: ("cockpit_push_subscriptions"."kind" = 'installation' AND "cockpit_push_subscriptions"."installation_id" IS NOT NULL AND "cockpit_push_subscriptions"."user_id" IS NULL) OR ("cockpit_push_subscriptions"."kind" = 'browser' AND "cockpit_push_subscriptions"."installation_id" IS NULL AND "cockpit_push_subscriptions"."user_id" IS NOT NULL)

connectors_mcp_auth_no_inline_secrets_ch.name: connectors_mcp_auth_no_inline_secrets_check
connectors_mcp_auth_no_inline_secrets_ch.value:
"connectors"."config" -> 'mcp' -> 'auth' IS NULL OR NOT (
        "connectors"."config" -> 'mcp' -> 'auth' ? 'client_secret' OR
        "connectors"."config" -> 'mcp' -> 'auth' ? 'password' OR
        "connectors"."config" -> 'mcp' -> 'auth' ? 'passphrase' OR
        "connectors"."config" -> 'mcp' -> 'auth' ? 'api_key' OR
        "connectors"."config" -> 'mcp' -> 'auth' ? 'apikey' OR
        "connectors"."config" -> 'mcp' -> 'auth' ? 'access_token' OR
        "connectors"."config" -> 'mcp' -> 'auth' ? 'refresh_token' OR
        "connectors"."config" -> 'mcp' -> 'auth' ? 'bearer_token' OR
        "connectors"."config" -> 'mcp' -> 'auth' ? 'secret'
      )

conversation_elicitations_decided_by_kin.name: conversation_elicitations_decided_by_kind_check
conversation_elicitations_decided_by_kin.value: ("conversation_elicitations"."decided_by_kind" IS NULL AND "conversation_elicitations"."decided_by" IS NULL) OR ("conversation_elicitations"."decided_by_kind" = 'unknown' AND "conversation_elicitations"."decided_by" IS NULL) OR ("conversation_elicitations"."decided_by_kind" IS NOT NULL AND "conversation_elicitations"."decided_by_kind" IN ('user', 'system_account') AND "conversation_elicitations"."decided_by" IS NOT NULL)

device_allowances_digest_check.name: device_allowances_digest_check
device_allowances_digest_check.value: ("device_allowances"."kind" = 'keep_out') = ("device_allowances"."digest" IS NULL) AND ("device_allowances"."digest" IS NULL OR "device_allowances"."digest" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$')

device_allowances_shape_check.name: device_allowances_shape_check
device_allowances_shape_check.value: ("device_allowances"."kind" = 'folder') = ("device_allowances"."access" IS NOT NULL) AND ("device_allowances"."access" IS NULL OR "device_allowances"."access" IN ('read', 'write')) AND ("device_allowances"."kind" = 'site') = ("device_allowances"."private" IS NOT NULL) AND ("device_allowances"."kind" = 'keep_out') = ("device_allowances"."keep_out_target" IS NOT NULL) AND ("device_allowances"."keep_out_target" IS NULL OR ("device_allowances"."keep_out_target" IN ('folder', 'app') AND "device_allowances"."entered_by" = 'person')) AND ("device_allowances"."kind" <> 'site' OR NOT "device_allowances"."private" OR "device_allowances"."entered_by" = 'person')

device_commands_counts_check.name: device_commands_counts_check
device_commands_counts_check.value: "device_commands"."generation" >= 0 AND "device_commands"."attempt" BETWEEN 1 AND 2 AND char_length("device_commands"."step_id") BETWEEN 1 AND 300 AND char_length("device_commands"."kind") BETWEEN 1 AND 40

device_uploads_size_check.name: device_uploads_size_check
device_uploads_size_check.value: "device_uploads"."size_bytes" BETWEEN 0 AND 94371840 AND char_length("device_uploads"."name") BETWEEN 1 AND 255

executions_tool_approval_shape_check.name: executions_tool_approval_shape_check
executions_tool_approval_shape_check.value:
"executions"."tool_approval_id" IS NULL OR
      ("executions"."source_kind" = 'saved' AND "executions"."workflow_id" IS NOT NULL AND
       "executions"."workflow_version_id" IS NOT NULL AND "executions"."execution_authority_id" IS NULL AND NOT "executions"."hold_writes")

executions_authority_saved_check.name: executions_authority_saved_check
executions_authority_saved_check.value:
"executions"."execution_authority_id" IS NULL OR
      ("executions"."source_kind" = 'saved' AND "executions"."workflow_id" IS NOT NULL AND "executions"."workflow_version_id" IS NOT NULL)

executions_authority_link_shape_check.name: executions_authority_link_shape_check
executions_authority_link_shape_check.value:
("executions"."authority_root_execution_id" IS NULL) = ("executions"."authority_call_path" IS NULL) AND
      ("executions"."authority_root_execution_id" IS NULL OR (
        "executions"."execution_authority_id" IS NULL AND "executions"."tool_approval_id" IS NULL AND
        NOT "executions"."hold_writes" AND "executions"."source_kind" = 'saved' AND
        "executions"."workflow_id" IS NOT NULL AND "executions"."workflow_version_id" IS NOT NULL AND
        "executions"."parent_execution_id" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM "executions"."authority_root_execution_id" AND
        jsonb_typeof("executions"."authority_call_path") = 'array' AND
        jsonb_array_length("executions"."authority_call_path") >= 1))

files_tenant_slug_uq.name: files_tenant_slug_uq
files_tenant_slug_uq.where: "files"."slug" IS NOT NULL AND "files"."deleted_at" IS NULL

hosted_work_admissions_job_check.name: hosted_work_admissions_job_check
hosted_work_admissions_job_check.value: ("hosted_work_admissions"."queue_name" IS NULL) = ("hosted_work_admissions"."job_id" IS NULL) AND ("hosted_work_admissions"."state" <> 'pending' OR "hosted_work_admissions"."job_id" IS NOT NULL)

api_keys_creator_identity_check.name: api_keys_creator_identity_check
api_keys_creator_identity_check.value: ("api_keys"."creator_kind" is null and "api_keys"."creator_id" is null) or ("api_keys"."creator_kind" is not null and "api_keys"."creator_kind" = 'system' and "api_keys"."creator_id" is null) or ("api_keys"."creator_kind" is not null and "api_keys"."creator_kind" in ('user', 'system_account') and "api_keys"."creator_id" is not null)

tenants_origin_owner_check.name: tenants_origin_owner_check
tenants_origin_owner_check.value: ("tenants"."origin" = 'self_hosted' AND "tenants"."owner_identity_id" IS NULL) OR ("tenants"."origin" = 'self_service' AND "tenants"."owner_identity_id" IS NOT NULL AND NOT "tenants"."is_operator")

tenants_deletion_schedule_check.name: tenants_deletion_schedule_check
tenants_deletion_schedule_check.value: ("tenants"."status" <> 'pending_deletion' AND "tenants"."deletion_requested_at" IS NULL AND "tenants"."deletion_scheduled_for" IS NULL) OR ("tenants"."status" = 'pending_deletion' AND "tenants"."origin" = 'self_service' AND "tenants"."deletion_requested_at" IS NOT NULL AND "tenants"."deletion_scheduled_for" IS NOT NULL AND "tenants"."deletion_requested_at" < "tenants"."deletion_scheduled_for")

intake_items_admitted_target_check.name: intake_items_admitted_target_check
intake_items_admitted_target_check.value: ("subkit"."intake_items"."admitted_target_kind" IS NULL AND "subkit"."intake_items"."admitted_target_id" IS NULL) OR ("subkit"."intake_items"."admitted_target_kind" IN ('knowledge', 'skill') AND "subkit"."intake_items"."admitted_target_id" IS NOT NULL)

intake_proposals_confirmed_target_check.name: intake_proposals_confirmed_target_check
intake_proposals_confirmed_target_check.value: ("subkit"."intake_proposals"."confirmed_target_kind" IS NULL AND "subkit"."intake_proposals"."confirmed_target_id" IS NULL) OR ("subkit"."intake_proposals"."confirmed_target_kind" IN ('knowledge', 'skill') AND "subkit"."intake_proposals"."confirmed_target_id" IS NOT NULL)

mcp_tasks_actor_kind_check.name: mcp_tasks_actor_kind_check
mcp_tasks_actor_kind_check.value: ("mcp_tasks"."actor_id" IS NULL) = ("mcp_tasks"."actor_kind" IS NULL) AND ("mcp_tasks"."actor_kind" IS NULL OR "mcp_tasks"."actor_kind" <> 'system')

personal_notes_archive_check.name: personal_notes_archive_check
personal_notes_archive_check.value: ("personal_notes"."archived_at" IS NULL) = ("personal_notes"."archive_reason" IS NULL) AND ("personal_notes"."archive_reason" IS NULL OR "personal_notes"."archive_reason" IN ('superseded', 'merged', 'expired', 'stale', 'contradicted', 'manual'))

personal_notes_abstract_check.name: personal_notes_abstract_check
personal_notes_abstract_check.value: ("personal_notes"."abstract_ciphertext" IS NULL) = ("personal_notes"."abstract_iv" IS NULL) AND ("personal_notes"."abstract_ciphertext" IS NULL) = ("personal_notes"."abstract_auth_tag" IS NULL)

workflow_authority_pair_requests_approve.name: workflow_authority_pair_requests_approved_check
workflow_authority_pair_requests_approve.value: ("workflow_authority_pair_requests"."state" = 'approved') = ("workflow_authority_pair_requests"."authority_id" IS NOT NULL AND "workflow_authority_pair_requests"."second_approver_id" IS NOT NULL)

scheduler_sweep_position_shape.name: scheduler_sweep_position_shape
scheduler_sweep_position_shape.value: ("scheduler_sweep_cursors"."after_id" IS NULL AND "scheduler_sweep_cursors"."epoch_upper_id" IS NULL AND "scheduler_sweep_cursors"."epoch_cutoff_at" IS NULL AND "scheduler_sweep_cursors"."lease_owner_boot_id" IS NULL AND "scheduler_sweep_cursors"."lease_token" IS NULL AND "scheduler_sweep_cursors"."lease_until" IS NULL) OR ("scheduler_sweep_cursors"."epoch" > 0 AND "scheduler_sweep_cursors"."epoch_upper_id" IS NOT NULL AND "scheduler_sweep_cursors"."epoch_cutoff_at" IS NOT NULL AND ("scheduler_sweep_cursors"."after_id" IS NULL OR "scheduler_sweep_cursors"."after_id" <= "scheduler_sweep_cursors"."epoch_upper_id"))

scheduler_sweep_lease_shape.name: scheduler_sweep_lease_shape
scheduler_sweep_lease_shape.value: ("scheduler_sweep_cursors"."lease_owner_boot_id" IS NULL AND "scheduler_sweep_cursors"."lease_token" IS NULL AND "scheduler_sweep_cursors"."lease_until" IS NULL) OR ("scheduler_sweep_cursors"."lease_owner_boot_id" IS NOT NULL AND "scheduler_sweep_cursors"."lease_token" IS NOT NULL AND "scheduler_sweep_cursors"."lease_until" IS NOT NULL)

scheduler_sweep_lease_bound.name: scheduler_sweep_lease_bound
scheduler_sweep_lease_bound.value: "scheduler_sweep_cursors"."lease_until" IS NULL OR ("scheduler_sweep_cursors"."lease_until" > "scheduler_sweep_cursors"."updated_at" AND "scheduler_sweep_cursors"."lease_until" <= "scheduler_sweep_cursors"."updated_at" + interval '60 seconds')

user_setup_preferences_approver_check.name: user_setup_preferences_approver_check
user_setup_preferences_approver_check.value: ("user_setup_preferences"."approver_kind" IS NULL AND "user_setup_preferences"."approver_email" IS NULL AND "user_setup_preferences"."approver_user_id" IS NULL AND "user_setup_preferences"."approver_invite_id" IS NULL) OR ("user_setup_preferences"."approver_kind" = 'self' AND "user_setup_preferences"."approver_email" IS NULL AND "user_setup_preferences"."approver_user_id" IS NULL AND "user_setup_preferences"."approver_invite_id" IS NULL) OR ("user_setup_preferences"."approver_kind" IN ('teammate', 'pair') AND char_length("user_setup_preferences"."approver_email") BETWEEN 3 AND 254)

user_setup_preferences_pause_check.name: user_setup_preferences_pause_check
user_setup_preferences_pause_check.value: "user_setup_preferences"."notifications_paused_until" IS NULL OR ("user_setup_preferences"."notifications_paused_at" IS NOT NULL AND "user_setup_preferences"."notifications_paused_until" > "user_setup_preferences"."notifications_paused_at")

columns.expression: (CASE WHEN "execution_id" IS NULL AND "patch_candidate_id" IS NULL THEN "summary" ELSE '' END)

tasks_admission_hold_check.name: tasks_admission_hold_check
tasks_admission_hold_check.value: ("tasks"."admission_hold_reason" IS NULL AND "tasks"."admission_hold_since" IS NULL) OR ("tasks"."admission_hold_since" IS NOT NULL AND "tasks"."admission_hold_reason" IN ('grant_required', 'grant_expired', 'grant_exhausted', 'grant_fingerprint_mismatch', 'owner_unavailable', 'ai_access_missing', 'previous_run_active', 'paused'))

tasks_paused_check.name: tasks_paused_check
tasks_paused_check.value: ("tasks"."paused_at" IS NULL AND "tasks"."paused_by" IS NULL AND "tasks"."paused_reason" IS NULL) OR ("tasks"."paused_at" IS NOT NULL AND "tasks"."paused_reason" IN ('owner_request', 'admin', 'owner_unavailable'))

usage_events_nonnegative_measurements_ch.name: usage_events_nonnegative_measurements_check
usage_events_nonnegative_measurements_ch.value: coalesce("usage_events"."duration_ms", 0) >= 0 AND coalesce("usage_events"."request_bytes", 0) >= 0 AND coalesce("usage_events"."response_bytes", 0) >= 0 AND coalesce("usage_events"."item_count", 0) >= 0 AND coalesce("usage_events"."active_sessions", 0) >= 0

workflow_authorities_revocation_check.name: workflow_authorities_revocation_check
workflow_authorities_revocation_check.value: ("workflow_execution_authorities"."revoked_at" IS NULL AND "workflow_execution_authorities"."revoked_by" IS NULL AND "workflow_execution_authorities"."superseded_by" IS NULL) OR ("workflow_execution_authorities"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL AND ("workflow_execution_authorities"."revoked_by" IS NOT NULL OR "workflow_execution_authorities"."superseded_by" IS NOT NULL))

workflow_review_receipts_completion_chec.name: workflow_review_receipts_completion_check
workflow_review_receipts_completion_chec.value: ("workflow_review_receipts"."status" = 'pending' AND "workflow_review_receipts"."completed_at" IS NULL) OR ("workflow_review_receipts"."status" = 'completed' AND "workflow_review_receipts"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL)

workflows_schedules_auto_pause_check.name: workflows_schedules_auto_pause_check
workflows_schedules_auto_pause_check.value: ("workflows_schedules"."paused_reason" IS NULL AND "workflows_schedules"."paused_at" IS NULL AND "workflows_schedules"."paused_failure_class" IS NULL AND "workflows_schedules"."paused_failure_count" IS NULL) OR ("workflows_schedules"."paused" AND "workflows_schedules"."paused_at" IS NOT NULL AND "workflows_schedules"."paused_reason" = 'repeated_failures' AND char_length("workflows_schedules"."paused_failure_class") BETWEEN 1 AND 200 AND "workflows_schedules"."paused_failure_count" >= 1)
